prompt: Knox learns to share the red truck
title: Share the Red Truck
irony: Knox grips the red truck to keep the fun to himself, yet solo pushing stalls the game, so sharing the driving turns holding tight into passing back and forth.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunny street glows as Knox straddles the shiny red truck by the curb while Benny watches with wide eyes.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Knox claims the red truck for a solo speed race down the sidewalk and tells Benny no turns, only watching.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Constance sets a kitchen timer on the fence for snack time and calls a clean-hands rule for the red truck.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Knox, Benny, Constance and Lou circle the red truck chanting the hook while tiny hands pat the shiny sides.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Knox tries to push and steer solo, the truck wobbles into the curb, and Benny stumbles back with dusty shoes.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Benny pushes fast, Knox yells dare words, the truck spins into soft grass and both tumble laughing beside it.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Knox, Benny, Constance and Lou circle the red truck chanting the hook again while tiny hands drum the shiny sides.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou wipes the diner counter, watches the street through the window, and feels the old stingy pinch loosen inside him.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou lifts a tray of warm pancakes and chooses sharing over extra syrup to model turn-taking outside.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Knox hands the handle to Benny, they swap push and steer, and Lou sings the turned line about sharing.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Sunny street glows again as Knox and Benny chant the hook and swap push and steer back and forth past the fence.
